history.empty.subtitle: Once you dictate, every session lives here with full provenance.
dictionary.title: Dictionary
dictionary.subtitle: Terms the cleanup LLM is told about. New entries appear in every future dictation.
dictionary.empty: No terms yet. Add one above, or mark something from History.
modes.title: Modes
modes.subtitle: Pick which transcription mode Right-Alt uses. AI command modes are separate — enable the ones you want and they get their own hotkey.
modes.section.transcription.help: Exactly one is active. Right-Alt always uses the selected mode.
modes.section.commands.help: Act on selected or clipboard text. Each has its own hotkey when enabled.
modes.desc.casual: For chats and messages. Tightens phrasing while keeping your natural voice — contractions and slang welcome, lists stay inline as prose.
modes.desc.normal: For email and docs. Balanced, polished prose. Renders bulleted or numbered lists when you explicitly ask for them.
modes.desc.formal: For reports, notes, and structured writing. Register-lifted output with headers, bullets, and numbered steps where appropriate.
modes.desc.rewrite: Edits the selected (or clipboard) text in place. Preserves meaning, improves clarity and flow.
modes.desc.expand: Turns a terse note or fragment into a fuller paragraph. Useful for fleshing out outlines.
modes.desc.summarize: Condenses a long block of text into a few sentences. Keeps the key points, drops the rest.
modes.field.model.help: Pick from your local Ollama installs, or type any tag. Cloud providers ignore this list.
modes.field.model.empty: No local Ollama models detected — Ollama may not be running.
settings.title: Settings
settings.general.sound.help: Soft chirp on start, gentle tick on done. Off by default.
settings.general.reducedMotion.help: Disables waveform animation, slide-in, and pulses. Honors system preference automatically.
settings.general.bg.title: Background photo
settings.general.bg.help: Display a slowly-panning photo from Unsplash behind the app. Rotates every 5 minutes. Your API key is stored locally on this machine.
settings.general.bg.enabled.needsKey: Add your Unsplash API key below to enable.
settings.general.bg.apiKey.help: Free from unsplash.com/developers. Demo keys give 50 requests/hour — enough for our 5-minute rotation.
settings.general.bg.categories.help: Pick one or more. The app picks a random photo from one of your selected categories each rotation.
settings.models.ollama.help: Ollama runs on your machine. Models live in your local Ollama install.
settings.models.claude.configured: API key configured — stored in Windows DPAPI.
settings.history.audioRetention.help: Off by default. Stores raw WAV in your data directory if on.
settings.history.purge.confirm: This deletes every session, transcript, and correction. It cannot be undone. Type PURGE to confirm.
settings.advanced.learning.help: Nightly job that classifies your corrections and improves the dictionary + style examples. Rolls back automatically on regression.
settings.advanced.telemetry: This app sends no data to Anthropic or to us. Everything is local. Crash logs stay on this machine.
about.title: About Mockingbird
about.tagline: Local-first, system-wide voice dictation. Your transcripts never leave your machine.
common.error: Couldn't complete that action — check logs for details.
meetings.title: Meetings
meetings.subtitle: Hours-long recordings — push to start, push to stop. Stays on your machine. Use Right Ctrl + M anywhere, or the buttons below.
meetings.source.label: Source
meetings.empty.title: No meetings recorded yet
meetings.empty.subtitle: Press Right Ctrl + M anywhere, or the Start button above. Recordings persist locally and never leave your machine.
meetings.detail.empty: Pick a meeting from the list to see its transcript.
meetings.detail.noTranscript: No transcript text for this channel.
meetings.llm.notRun: No LLM pass run yet. Pick a prompt and click Run to generate one.
meetings.llm.invariant: LLM-pass output is held in memory only — it never touches the canonical transcript.
meetings.llm.ephemeralNotice.body: This output isn’t saved — export it now (Save As… or Copy) if you want to keep it.
meetingOverlay.title: Start a meeting
meetingOverlay.subtitle: Push to start. Push to stop. Stays on this machine.
